scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:tests
scripts.test:unit: bun run build && bun test packages/model/test/unit packages/agent/test/unit packages/coding/test/unit
scripts.test:contract: bun run build && bun test packages/model/test/contract packages/agent/test/contract packages/coding/test/contract test/contract
scripts.test:integration: bun run build && bun test test/integration
scripts.test:system: bun run build && bun test test/system packages/sqlite/test/system
scripts.test:acceptance: bun run build && bun test test/acceptance
scripts.test:model: bun run build && bun test packages/model/test
scripts.test:cli: bun run build && bun --no-env-file scripts/run-m1-deterministic-print.mjs --print "read test/fixtures/openai/final-answer.sse"
scripts.test:coverage: bun run build && bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter=text --coverage-reporter=lcov && bun --no-env-file scripts/check-bun-coverage.mjs 75
scripts.test:boundary: bun run build && bun --no-env-file scripts/check-package-boundaries.mjs && bun --no-env-file scripts/check-package-exports.mjs
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:unit && bun run test:contract && bun run test:integration && bun run test:system && bun run test:acceptance && bun run test:boundary && bun run test:coverage && bun run scan:production && bun run audit:dependencies
